description: Fix ThemeService CSS variable output: app.blade.php never outputs theme CSS variables, and the @push('head') in builder.blade.php is silently dropped because app.blade.php has no @stack('head'). Fix both: add @stack('head') to app.blade.php and inject theme CSS variables directly into the layout head.
steps: Open resources/views/frontend/layouts/app.blade.php. Locate the line `@vite(['resources/css/app.css', 'resources/js/app.js'])`. Immediately before that line, add a @php block that calls `app(\App\Services\ThemeService::class)->applyThemeStyles()` and outputs it inside a <style> tag if non-empty: `@php $themeStyles = app(\App\Services\ThemeService::class)->applyThemeStyles(); @endphp @if($themeStyles)<style>{!! $themeStyles !!}</style>@endif`.

In the same file resources/views/frontend/layouts/app.blade.php, find the closing `</head>` tag. Immediately before it, add `@stack('head')` so that pages using @push('head') (like builder.blade.php) can add extra head content.

Open resources/views/frontend/page/builder.blade.php. The existing @push('head') block already calls ThemeService. Remove ONLY the ThemeService call from that @push block (since the layout now handles it globally) but keep the canonical/og/twitter/structureddata meta tags. This prevents duplicate theme CSS injection.
Verify ThemeService::applyThemeStyles() does not crash when no active theme exists (it returns '' — confirm via code review of the method, no change needed).
acceptance_criteria: Visiting any frontend page (/, /blog, /any-slug) shows `<style>:root { --theme-primary:` in the page source <head>
builder.blade.php no longer calls ThemeService (layout handles it), but still pushes canonical/og/twitter meta
php artisan view:clear completes without errors
No 500 errors on frontend pages when no active theme is set (ThemeService returns empty string)
verification: php artisan view:clear && php artisan config:clear
Open browser to any frontend page, view source, search for '--theme-primary' in <head> section
